newsitem.title: USA: SERVICE UNIT UPS STAKE IN ARBOR.
newsitem.headline: SERVICE UNIT UPS STAKE IN ARBOR.

text.p: Service Corp International said Monday its Service Corp International Ltd subidiary increased its stake of Arbor Memorial Service Inc to 59 percent of the shares outstanding.
Service Corp said the subsidiary agreed to acquire 713,825 class A voting shares and 2,213,152 class B non-voting shares in Arbor from Loewen Group Inc.
After completing the transaction, SCI will own 960,969 class A voting shares and 5,270,227 class B non-voting shares of Arbor.
The shares represent about 38 percent of class A voting shares, 66 percent of class B non-voting shares and 59 percent of the total shares of Arbor outstanding.
